messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In case of an overdose, get medical help.
In case of an overdose, contact a live Poison Center expert right away.
The Poison Center expert can be reached at 1-800-222-1222.
Advice is also available online at poisonhelp.org.
Triplet: ["Poison Center expert", "can be reached at", "1-800-222-1222"]

The relation 'can be reached at' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity can be contacted or accessed through the phone number specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has information page': The subject entity has an information page specified by the object entity.
B. 'located in': The subject entity is situated or based in the location specified by the object entity.
C. 'can be administered by': The subject entity can be given by the object entity in the specified situation.
D. 'is type of': The subject entity is a specific type or category of the object entity.
E. 'has reporting contact': The subject drug has a designated contact entity specified by the object for reporting side effects or adverse events.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
